pages.title: Nightgrove Longbow
pages.text: Carved from the dark heartwood of the Nightgrove, this longbow carries a faint cyan glow that wakes whenever you draw it. Every arrow it looses strikes for 2 more damage than one from a common bow, and with 576 uses it lasts half again as long. It takes the same enchantments as any bow.

pages.title: Recipe
pages.text: Three Nightgrove Sticks and three strings, laid out like a common bow. Nightgrove Sticks will not make a common bow.
